decisions.title: Electrocatalytic Carbon Dioxide Reduction Coupled with Alcohol Oxidation
decisions.evidenceBasis: Electrocatalytic CO2-reduction/alcohol-oxidation paired process; primary contribution is electrocatalysis/energy conversion rather than a general preparative organic method.
decisions.challengeReason: Alcohol oxidation is synthetically recognizable, but absent evidence of a general preparative organic-method scope, the energy/electrocatalysis exclusion controls.

decisions.title: Disentangling Electronic and Lattice Contributions to Transient Absorption in Metal Halide Perovskites: A First-Principles Study of CH3NH3PbBr3
decisions.evidenceBasis: First-principles transient-absorption theory and molecular dynamics for a metal-halide perovskite; no preparative organic transformation.
decisions.challengeReason: Perovskite spectroscopy/theory is outside synthetic methodology.

decisions.title: Enantioselective Defluorinative C(sp2)–H Allylation of Acrylamides Enabled by CpxRh(III) Catalysis
decisions.evidenceBasis: New catalytic asymmetric C(sp2)-H functionalization/defluorinative coupling with broad scope, up to 99% yield and 99% ee, plus divergent chiral 2-piperidone synthesis.
decisions.challengeReason: Direct general synthetic methodology with substrate scope and stereocontrol.

decisions.title: Non-Canonical Peptide Self-Assembly for Mitochondria-Specific Cargo Delivery
decisions.evidenceBasis: Biomedical peptide self-assembly, mitochondrial drug delivery and immune modulation; synthesis is enabling rather than methodological.
decisions.challengeReason: Biomedical delivery study, not a general synthetic method.

decisions.title: Isoindole-Based Multicomponent Synthesis of Pyrimido[6,1,2-cd]pyrrolizine Fluorophores with Unsymmetrical Urea Handles: Photophysical, Theoretical, and Antifungal Imaging Studies
decisions.evidenceBasis: Diversity-oriented one-pot multicomponent strategy generates a library of fluorophores from accessible precursors; imaging is downstream application.
decisions.challengeReason: General multicomponent library-synthesis method with structural diversity satisfies methodology scope despite application-heavy characterization.

decisions.title: All the ways a cell can die — and why the variety matters
decisions.evidenceBasis: Nature d41586 news/features item on cell-death biology.
decisions.challengeReason: News/editorial biological coverage is explicitly excluded.

decisions.title: Hundreds of ‘free’ academic journals have started charging fees
decisions.evidenceBasis: Nature d41586 news/features item on academic publishing fees.

decisions.title: Direct C1–H Amination of Free NH Carbazoles Enabled by the Catellani Reaction
decisions.evidenceBasis: First Pd/NBE-catalyzed direct C1-H amination of unprotected carbazoles with broad cyclic-amine scope and functional-group tolerance.
decisions.challengeReason: Explicit new catalytic C-H amination methodology with scope and synthetic utility.
